message.content:
This editorial magazine cover features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, white, serif letters across the top. Below the masthead, smaller text reads "EDISI 28 JANUARI-3 FEBRUARI 2013". Above the masthead, text includes "BUKTI KETERLIBATAN CHOEL MALLARANGENG" and "SURYA PALOH VS HARY TANOE".

The main image depicts a crowded outdoor scene in a flooded area. Dozens of people are wading through chest-to-waist-deep murky water. In the center, an amphibious vehicle with metal treads is partially submerged. A person in a green and brown camouflage uniform and a pink beret sits on the vehicle, reaching towards the crowd.

Numerous people of various ages are visible. Some carry belongings like boxes and bags. One person in a blue shirt reaches out towards the vehicle. In the foreground, people are viewed from behind, looking toward the flooded scene. Large white text in the bottom-left corner reads "PLUIT RIWAYATMU KINI". A barcode and pricing information, "RP 29.700", are located in the bottom-left corner. The background shows blurred structures and stalls.
